newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Industrial production up in most of Brazil - IBGE.
newsitem.headline: Industrial production up in most of Brazil - IBGE.

text.p: Brazilian industrial production increased in January in nine out of 10 regions surveyed when compared with January 1996, the National Statistics Institute said (IBGE).
The northeastern state of Pernambuco was the only area in which industrial production fell in January, down 4.4 percent on January the previous year, the IBGE said.
It said the decrease was led by the clothing and food sectors and the electrical and communications material sector.

The southern state of Rio Grande do Sul recorded the best performance in industrial production, up 13.5 percent, followed by the southern region at 10.9 percent, Santa Catarina state at 10.6 percent and Parana state at 8.2 percent, the IBGE said.
Industrial output grew 5.3 percent in Minas Gerais state, 5.2 percent in Rio de Janeiro and Sao Paulo, 4.7 percent in the Northeast and Bahia state.
((--Simona de Logu, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 507 4151))
